title: Duolingo Expands Its Math Services for More Advanced and Personalized Learning - CNET
summary: A couple of years back, Duolingo expanded beyond its language learning services to include math and music. Beyond the guides, Duolingo Math is rolling out features to support students when they get stuck on a topic.
